verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a real-time video API platform, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Daily's hosted cloud infrastructure and offers no self-hosted deployment of the core video platform. The open-source Pipecat framework is a separate orchestration product, and storing recordings in your own bucket is an adjacent feature; neither shows the core product can be self-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
